{{Quote|Oh, no. It's Teradoc's. We stole it.|Garik Loran about the yacht|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
A '''yacht''' was owned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]]. It was elegantly long and painted in Imperial-style white. Inside it had a grill, a bar, and weather-resistant furnishings.<ref name="MK" />

Sometime in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], it was stolen by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] group [[Wraith Squadron]] after successfully [[Death/Legends|killing]] the admiral.<ref name="MK" />
